name: Dub Together
summary: 多人配音派对游戏。开发者披露部分美术（两名玩家角色、logo、菜单图标、幕布贴图）由 AI 图像生成后再手工修改，英文界面文本在语言模型协助下撰写，德语文本为人工撰写；内置 Pack Creator 使用语音识别模型、AI 降噪与人声/背景分离，全部本地运行且不外传数据。

aiAreaNotes.ingame: 披露称内置的 Pack Creator 使用语音识别模型从玩家自备视频中提取台词，AI 降噪与人声/背景分离也属游戏内功能；官方强调全部本地运行、不外传数据、模型不自行编造内容。
aiAreaNotes.code: 本次官方披露未明确说明此领域；不能据此认定未使用。
aiAreaNotes.art: 披露称部分美术由 AI 图像生成器完成后再手工修改，具体包括两名玩家角色、logo、菜单图标与幕布贴图。

aiAreaNotes.voice: 披露称麦克风录音使用 AI 降噪，并对人声与背景音频做 AI 分离。

sources.label: Steam 商店完整 AI 披露
sources.excerpt: Some of the artwork in this game was made with AI image generators and edited by hand afterwards. This covers the two player characters, the logo, the menu icons and the curtain texture. The English interface texts were written with the help of a language model and reviewed afterwards. The German texts are written by hand. The bundled Pack Creator uses a speech recognition model to find the spoken parts of a video you supply yourself and turn them into the lines you read out. An AI noise filter for your microphone recordings and AI-based separation of speech and background audio work the same way. All of this runs locally on your own machine and never sends data to an external service. These models only process material you provide yourself, they do not invent content of their own, and the result stays inside your own lobby.

english.summary: A multiplayer dubbing party game. The developer states some artwork made with AI image generators was edited by hand, covering the two player characters, the logo, the menu icons and the curtain texture; the English interface texts were written with the help of a language model while the German texts were handwritten, and the bundled Pack Creator uses a local speech recognition model plus AI noise filtering and speech separation without sending data to any external service.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer Banani) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 150); no homepage topic directly concerns AI use and individual threads were not opened. This title was searched 1 time with 6 results and 1 raw source(s) were read. Every area finding comes from the store disclosure text itself and rests on the developer's own statement, without an independent audit.

aiAreaNotes.ingame: The bundled Pack Creator uses a speech recognition model to extract spoken parts from a video the player supplies, and the AI noise filter and speech/background separation are in-game features; the developer stresses this runs locally, sends no data out and that the models do not invent content.
